versions.changelog:
- Initial release of design-assets-index.
- Provides a categorized index of top design asset sites for photos, icons, fonts, color palettes, mockups, UI kits, and templates.
- Each category features 2-3 top resource links with brief descriptions.
- Full reference lists for each asset type are available in the references/ directory.
- Sourced from popular repositories: awesome-design and design-resources-for-developers.
